data.long_meaning: Anso is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Anus' which means 'graceful' or 'aiming'. In Hindu mythology, Anso is a name associated with the god Vishnu, symbolizing the graceful manifestation of his divine power. The name Anso carries the meaning “Graceful, Aiming” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anso usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, aiming and live with faith, good character and purpose.
